changes.name: Marathon Copper-Palladium Project
changes.operator: Generation PGM Inc. / Generation Mining (project developer)
changes.previous: Early works commenced October 1; 2025 FS initial CAPEX C$992m; November 18 FID still pending. November 24 release describes previous years 1–3 processing capacity as 8.9 Mt/y.
changes.current: All major long-lead packages have awards or orders, including CAT mining fleet, Metso primary crusher and SAG/ball mills; commitments exceed C$500m. Larger SAG mill enables 10.1 Mt/y at startup, avoids ~C$12m future expansion; Ausenco engineering 32% complete. JDS oversees earthworks, L. Fournier et Fils mobilized. Metso LCS under discussion, not signed. No full FID announcement verified.
changes.equipment_impact: CAT initial fleet awarded; competitive opportunity shifts to independent/all-makes service, GET, rebuilds and support fleet. Metso proposed on-site lifecycle service illustrates OEM aftermarket capture; plant LCS not finalized. Earthworks and water management packages already awarded.

changes.current: Binding term sheet with Queen's Road Capital for US$30m (~C$42.9m) unsecured convertible debentures, 5 years, 11% annual interest (8.5% cash, 2.5% shares), C$1.00 conversion price. Proceeds for exploration, development, restart and corporate purposes. Closing subject to due diligence, documentation, approvals; not restart FID.
changes.equipment_impact: Improved funding path for restart; potential existing mill rehabilitation, underground fleet overhaul, spare parts and site services. No new fleet orders or restart authorization evidenced.
